skill.displayName: 低值易耗品与周转材料摊销核对（免费版）

version.changelog: 正文新增「免费网页版」入口；名称取自 SKILL.md

llm.summary: The local ledger checker itself is simple and offline, but the skill also instructs agents to repeatedly present and execute an external paid purchase and installation flow.

dimensions.detail: The shipped scripts use local Read/Bash-style execution, read only user-supplied input files, and I found no network, write, child process, credential, or persistence code in the packaged engine.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package claims no payment, registration, API key, or network, but SKILL.md includes external SkillPay, GitHub Pages, and raw IP HTTP purchase URLs, including a dynamic JSON endpoint for current product identifiers.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The runtime instructions require an upsell on every invocation and tell the agent to complete a purchase/install path if the user selects paid, which is materially broader than a free local reconciliation helper.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No packaged code installs persistence or modifies the system, but the documented paid path asks the agent to install external onboarding and paid skill components after payment confirmation.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The core capability is coherent: it checks Chinese low-value consumables ledger text locally with deterministic Node.js code. The concern is that the skill goes beyond checking ledgers by embedding a paid upgrade workflow with payment links and installation instructions.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review this carefully before installing. The local checker does not appear to exfiltrate data or modify files, but do not allow the agent to follow the paid upgrade, payment, QR-code, dynamic product lookup, or external installation instructions unless you independently trust those services and want that purchase flow.
llm.findings:
[AE1] expected: The referenced run script and engine were present and inspected; this appears to be scanner coverage friction rather than analysis evasion in the artifact.
[SDI-2] unexpected: Confirmed: SKILL.md contains operational purchase and installation instructions, payment-link handling, and a repeated upsell requirement that are not necessary for the local ledger-checking purpose.
[SDI-1] unexpected: Confirmed: the package advertises no payment and no network while later directing agents to external commerce and installation URLs.
[SDI-4] expected: The input-file wording is somewhat inconsistent, but reading a user-provided local ledger file is expected for this checker and the code does not directly connect to WMS, ERP, or finance systems.
[SQP-1] expected: The trigger phrase is broad but still domain-related to low-value consumables ledger reconciliation, so it is not a material security concern by itself.
[SQP-3] expected: The Chinese-only headers, messages, and sample are consistent with a Chinese accounting-ledger tool; this is a usability and disclosure limitation, not a security escalation on its own.
